alt: 同一個孩子持續每次存入一枚小硬幣，連續小景裡透明罐從幾枚硬幣逐漸變成滿罐，窗台植物也慢慢長大。
scene_prompt: Modern child saving a single small plain coin regularly. Three connected soft-edged time scenes from left to right show SAME child and SAME transparent jar: first just a few coins, then half-full after repeated tiny deposits, finally a large full jar as child adds one more tiny coin with proud smile. A windowsill plant grows from sprout to leafy plant across scenes to indicate time, not three different simultaneous jars. Emphasize many small savings accumulating into substantial total, no winning lottery or large single donation. Modern cozy bedroom desk, no readable coin symbols, text, dates, numbers, brands logos watermarks. Natural hands two arms five fingers, coin falls downward into wide jar opening, stable desk, perspective coherent. Landscape 3:2 graphite pencil soft watercolor colored pencil on ivory textured paper.
